title: Aeropuerto Arturo Merino Benítez 22 — FINAL v2
subtitle: DGAC Office — Regulatory Denial of Responsibility
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL), Santiago, Chile — DGAC Office
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

cluster_A_DGAC_intermediary_role.summary: DGAC/LATAM officials explain their intermediary role: they act on the captain's word without investigation, then hand passengers to PDI. Legitimacy of the reason is explicitly deferred to the airline ('tema de la compañía').
cluster_A_DGAC_intermediary_role.reasoning: DGAC officials describe a trust-based removal system with no real-time verification mechanism. The captain makes the removal request; DGAC trusts it without independent inquiry, takes the passenger, and hands them to PDI. The official states, 'Si eso es o no legítimo, eso es ya tema de la compañía' — whether the reason is legitimate is the airline's problem. This architecture offers no protection against false accusations.

cluster_B_rehuso_a_bajar_framing.summary: LATAM/DGAC official frames Leandro's refusal to immediately disembark as 'se rehusó a bajar' — the basis for the 'insubordinado' classification. Leandro challenges the circular logic.
cluster_B_rehuso_a_bajar_framing.reasoning: The official elides the causal chain: false accusation → captain's removal order → passenger questions it → passenger is labeled 'insubordinado' for questioning. Questioning a false accusation becomes the violation. This directly supports F-014 (causal inversion) and F-019 (disruptivo label).

cluster_C_PDI_dismissal_acknowledged.summary: CRITICAL: LATAM/DGAC official acknowledges the false accusation as the cause of removal, confirms PDI dismissed everything, admits LATAM persists regardless, and says 'yo tampoco me explico eso'.
cluster_C_PDI_dismissal_acknowledged.reasoning: Official states: 'El motivo por el cual usted... fue desembarcado fue porque él hizo una acusación falsa' — on-tape corroboration that removal was based on false accusations. Confirms PDI 'desestimaron todo'. Notes LATAM continues with boarding pass story despite PDI dismissal. Admits personal incomprehension: 'yo tampoco me explico eso' — institutional dysfunction admitted by insider.
cluster_C_PDI_dismissal_acknowledged.violation_linkage: F-003 (false accusations acknowledged by official), F-004 (post-hoc persistence), F-016 (system produces results even officials find inexplicable)

cluster_D_document_exists_not_for_passen.summary: Official confirms disembarkation document exists but is 'para el capital y es para la DGAC'. Leandro cites Ley 20.831; official acknowledges but withholds document.
cluster_D_document_exists_not_for_passen.reasoning: The LATAM/DGAC official confirms the document's existence and clarifies its restricted distribution. Leandro cites a specific statute to assert his right. This directly corroborates T2 seg 178 and STG_15 seg 30 (cellphone document), confirming the document is a formal internal record systematically withheld from the passenger.
cluster_D_document_exists_not_for_passen.violation_linkage: F-005 (documentation withheld), F-017 (cellphone document now confirmed as formal internal record)

cluster_E_ping_pong_confirmed.summary: Leandro describes the buck-passing loop: PDI told him to ask LATAM, LATAM told him to ask PDI. Third 'ping-pong' reference across timeline. Official acknowledges situation is unpleasant.
cluster_E_ping_pong_confirmed.reasoning: This is the third 'ping-pong' reference (STG_15 seg 45, T2 seg 41, now STG_22 seg 164). Leandro's physical state is documented: needs medication, hungry, extremely stressed, no flight after 7+ hours. Official acknowledges 'no es la casa para nadie'. The circular routing between institutions effectively denies the passenger any access to documentation.
cluster_E_ping_pong_confirmed.violation_linkage: F-016 (internal-channel capture — circular routing), F-002 (bearing — distressed, not aggressive)

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: DGAC trust-based removal system: acts on captain's word without verification; legitimacy is 'tema de la compañía'
Official acknowledges false accusation as cause of removal — 'porque él hizo una acusación falsa'
PDI dismissal confirmed by official — 'desestimaron todo lo que dijo'
'Yo tampoco me explico eso' — official admits incomprehension at LATAM's persistence
Document exists but is 'para el capital y para la DGAC' — not for passenger
Leandro cites Ley 20.831 to DGAC; official acknowledges ('EXACTO')
